subject: Re: Tethys dedicated sizing validation & cutover timeline
messages:
From: Linda Gao <linda@tethys.ai>
To: maya_srinivasan@redwood.example
Cc: ops@tethys.ai, procurement@tethys.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 14:32:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted -> Dedicated: initial sizing numbers and ask

Hi Maya,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Tethys is ready to commit to Dedicated capacity if we can validate performance under our mixed workload (high-embedding churn + peak chat traffic). Attached is our current usage export and a rough cost cap. High level asks:

- Can Redwood validate that the proposed GPU mix (4x A100-80GB equiv) will meet our 99th percentile latency target of 250ms for chat?
- We need a cutover window in early November with rollback safety nets.
- Procurement wants a clear acceptance test document (so they can sign the SOW).

I've attached tethys-sizing-model_v2.xlsx with expected concurrency and peak windows. Can your team propose a validation plan and a target swap date by EOD next week?

Regards,
Linda Gao
Head of ML Ops | Tethys AI

Attachments: tethys-sizing-model_v2.xlsx

From: maya_srinivasan@redwood.example
To: Linda Gao <linda@tethys.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.example, ben_carter@redwood.example
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 15:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted -> Dedicated: initial sizing numbers and ask

Thanks Linda — looping in Karthik and Ben to own sizing validation and the cutover plan. High-level response below; we'll follow up with a draft validation checklist by Thursday.

Summary response:
- We can replicate your traffic profile in our staged Dedicated environment and run a 72-hour soak with traffic mirroring to validate 99p latency and tail behavior.
- Proposed GPU mix is plausible but we want to run an experiment matrix: A100-80GB x4 (baseline), A100 x6 (higher concurrency), and a quantized 8-bit variant on mixed instance types to assess cost/perf tradeoffs.
- Acceptance gates: 99p latency <= 250ms, token error rate < 1%, no more than 3% request drop during peak bursts, and successful failover to hosted fallback under capacity saturation.

Deliverables and dates:
- Thu 09/23: Validation checklist + traffic injection plan (draft)
- Mon 09/27: Staging runbook + tentative swap windows (first pass)
- Week of 10/12: Full soak in Dedicated with mirrored live load (if staging passes)
- Target cutover week: 11/02 - we will propose a single-night swap with a 72-hour monitored rollback window.

I'll also attach a lightweight commit matrix (commit-matrix.pdf) with roles and rollback triggers.

-Maya
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.example
To: maya_srinivasan@redwood.example, Linda Gao <linda@tethys.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.example, priyom_das@redwood.example
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted -> Dedicated: validation checklist (draft)

Linda, Maya — attaching the draft validation checklist below and a short rundown of the experiment matrix.

--- Validation checklist (draft) ---
1) Baseline profiling: run traffic replay against hosted model for a 24h baseline (verify sequence length distribution, tokens/sec).
2) Staging perf runs: three configurations, each 24h bursts + simulated diurnal cycles.
   - Config A: 4x A100-80GB (customer proposed)
   - Config B: 6x A100 (higher concurrency)
   - Config C: 4x A100 + 2x q8 quantized nodes (cost experiment)
3) Soak acceptance: 72h soak on chosen config with live traffic mirroring (no writes to production). Observe latency tails and KV cache hit rates.
4) Failure & fallback drills: induce individual GPU node failures, force routing to hosted fallback, validate transparent client retry behavior.
5) Post-cutover acceptance: 24h smoke tests, 7-day monitoring window with automatic rollback if SLOs breach.

Experiment telemetry we will collect: per-route 99p latency, per-token cost, GPU utilization breakdown, KV cache hit rate, unit economics per 1000 reqs.

Tentative slots for staging runs: Oct 12-14 (config runs), Oct 19-21 (72h soak). Proposed cutover nights: Nov 2-4 (primary), Nov 9-11 (fallback).

We will provide runbooks for each run and a quick checklist for Tethys to validate and sign. Ben, can you confirm resource availability in the staging pool for the Oct windows?

-Karthik

From: ben_carter@redwood.example
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.example, maya_srinivasan@redwood.example, Linda Gao <linda@tethys.ai>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.example
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted -> Dedicated: validation checklist (resource confirmation)

Confirming resource reservations:
- Staging pool: we can reserve a temporary cluster matching Config A and C for Oct 12-14 and Oct 19-21.
- I added a 10% buffer capacity to account for flaky retries during stress runs.
- Ops will run the failure/fallback drills during the soak; we will coordinate maintenance blackout windows to avoid noisy neighbors.

Action items for Tethys:
1) Please sign the attached commit-matrix.pdf to authorize temporary capacity reservation and specify the SOW acceptance approver.
2) Send a sanitized sample token set for traffic replay (PII scrubbed) by Oct 5 so we can generate realistic replay traffic.

Ben
Sr. Capacity Planner | Redwood Inference
Attachments: commit-matrix.pdf

From: Linda Gao <linda@tethys.ai>
To: maya_srinivasan@redwood.example
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.example, ben_carter@redwood.example, priyom_das@redwood.example, procurement@tethys.ai
Date: Tue, 05 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted -> Dedicated: validation checklist (final)

Maya/Karthik/Ben — thanks for the detailed plan. Procurement has signed the commit-matrix and uploaded it to the Drive link you shared. We will deliver the sanitized replay tokens by EOD Oct 5.

One ask from my CTO: could Redwood include a short appendix in the acceptance doc that lists the exact rollback triggers (numeric thresholds) and the on-call rotation for the 72-hour post-swap monitoring window? Procurement wants that explicitly in the SOW to approve the final billing milestone.

If you can send the final validation checklist (with rollback triggers) by Oct 8, we will lock the swap window for Nov 2 night.

Thanks,
Linda
Head of ML Ops | Tethys AI
